title.es: Prepararse para la primera entrevista de trabajo
title.en: Preparing for a First Job Interview

intro.es: Practica lectura de inglés A2 con un texto original sobre employment.
intro.en: Practise A2 English reading with an original text about employment.

mission.es: Identifica la idea global, comprueba la evidencia y reconstruye la secuencia.
mission.en: Identify the main idea, check evidence, and reconstruct the sequence.

content.targetText: Before her first job interview, Noor wrote down examples of times when she had solved a problem, helped a customer, or learned a new task. She did not memorise long answers because she wanted to sound natural. The evening before the interview, she checked the bus route and prepared two questions about the role. At the office, the manager asked about teamwork and reliability. Noor gave one clear example for each question and admitted when she did not know a technical word. She left without knowing the result, but she felt prepared because she had shown how she worked rather than only describing her qualities. For planning purposes, readers should check the time, the conditions, and the person responsible. These details may change, so the safest choice is to confirm them before taking the next step. The message gives guidance, but people still need to make a practical decision.
